layers.label: Dark Aether — Al Mazrah City / Highrise
layers.note: Overhead reference: floating contract starters, roof exits and ground-floor rooms have different heights. The Infinite Cosmos route is Elder-only. Follow actual launch pads/Tears and the guide photographs; the map does not draw a safe aerial walking route.

locations.description: Reach the floating Peeks starter using a safe available pad/Tear route. The ground-floor objective can be at a different height from this starter.

locations.label: Post Office Warehouse — locked door · E7
locations.description: Optional equipment room. Search for the matching warehouse key in this visit; this door is separate from the Infinite Cosmos maintenance door.

locations.label: Post Office Warehouse key candidate · G3
locations.description: Check the photographed candidate hiding place for the warehouse key. It does not unlock the Infinite Cosmos maintenance tower.

locations.label: Highrise — detector maze and lobby search
locations.description: Elder-only Infinite Cosmos: search under the main Highrise building for the unmarked spore and R4D detector, follow its arrows for the skull, then find the Golden Whale lobby across from the detector building. This broad footprint does not pinpoint the spore, skull or whale head.
locations.floor: Under Highrise / ground-floor maze and nearby lobby

locations.label: Spec Electronics — computer search
locations.description: Search the C3 Spec Electronics building and its second-floor error-screen computer. Carry the IT Thumb Drive; activate the computer before fighting the marked Keyholder.

locations.label: Highrise maintenance door search
locations.description: Return to the roof/exfil level with the Maintenance Tower Key. Find its locked maintenance door and bring every squad member inside before using the purple boss portal.
